name: Visitor Visa (TRV) and eTA

requirements.blocker_text: This requires showing you'll leave Canada at the end of your visit.
This requires holding a passport from a visa-exempt country and applying for an eTA before flying to Canada.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of sufficient funds and intent to leave

outcome.duration_length: TRV typically valid up to 10 years or passport expiry, each visit generally up to 6 months; eTA valid up to 5 years or passport expiry, each visit generally up to 6 months

notes: TRV fee $100/person (family maximum $500) + $85 biometrics; eTA fee just $7, approved within minutes in most cases — a genuinely low-friction visa-exempt product. Processing time (outside Canada, TRV) varies significantly by country: roughly 17 days (Philippines) to 48 days (Pakistan) per country-specific estimates from the underlying research. Official applications should only be made via canada.ca/eta — a genuine warning worth surfacing given the pattern (seen across multiple countries in this dataset) of third-party sites charging inflated fees for straightforward government processes.
